tables.summary: 13-tile Hong Kong Mahjong. Minimum 3 faan, cap 10, discarder pays the whole hand, flowers do not score. Based on the HKMA rulebook (17 May 2023); RULES.md lists where it differs.
tables.title: Hong Kong Mahjong, HKMA Classical

tables.summary: 13-tile Hong Kong Mahjong, House rules. Minimum 3 faan, cap 13, the discarder pays the whole hand, flowers score, limit hands are graded 6 / 8 / 10 / 13, and Seven Pairs is a hand (4 faan, concealed only). RULES.md has the full table.
tables.title: Hong Kong Mahjong, House rules

tables.summary: 13-tile Hong Kong Mahjong, chicken-hand rules. The same as HKMA Classical (cap 10, flowers do not score, no Seven Pairs) except that the minimum is 0 faan, so a complete hand with no scoring pattern may win, and every win pays the same: the winner collects 3 and each other seat pays 1, self-drawn or off a discard. Points a hand are then a straight-line function of win rate, and the aim is to win, so the table is ranked by win rate. RULES.md has the details.
tables.title: Hong Kong Mahjong, Chicken hand
